references.title: 신규 프로젝트 형식→에디터

observed_steps.title: Template / Format Entry
observed_steps.goal: Start creating a new video project and choose a target format from available templates
observed_steps.action: Click 'New Project' (top-right) or select a template thumbnail (Instagram Story, TikTok, Reel, etc.)
observed_steps.system_response: Opens the 'New Video Project' modal centered on screen (project metadata and upload options).

observed_steps.title: New Project Modal (Defaults)
observed_steps.goal: Provide project name, confirm default size/format, and optionally upload media before starting
observed_steps.action: Type a project name, review the preselected Size & Format field, optionally click Upload to add files, then press 'Let's Start'
observed_steps.system_response: Modal accepts input; if mandatory fields are present it enables the start action. No navigation yet until 'Let's Start' is tapped.

observed_steps.title: Size & Format Selector
observed_steps.goal: Choose the output aspect ratio / platform format for the project
observed_steps.action: Open the Size & Format dropdown and select the desired preset (TikTok, YouTube, IG post, Wide Landscape, etc.)
observed_steps.system_response: Dropdown displays preset options; selecting one updates the Size & Format field in the modal and highlights the chosen preset.

observed_steps.title: Confirm Project Details
observed_steps.goal: Finalize project metadata (name + format) and prepare to launch the editor
observed_steps.action: Verify the project name (example: 'Party #1 / teaser'), confirm Size & Format, optionally upload files, then click 'Let's Start'
observed_steps.system_response: Modal closes and the system creates/initializes the project with provided metadata (and uploaded files if any). The editor is prepared and the project title is set.

observed_steps.title: Blank Editor Initialized
observed_steps.goal: Begin editing the newly created project with an empty canvas and timeline
observed_steps.action: Use the editor controls (timeline, import buttons, play) to add media and start editing
observed_steps.system_response: Editor opens with the project name shown at the top, an empty preview canvas, and an initialized timeline. Share and Export controls are available; the project is ready to receive media and edits.

references.adopt: 프로젝트명/화면비/파일을 한정한 생성 전 설정
references.limitation: Refero가 해석한 캡처 기반 happy path다. 오류·권한·정산 분기는 우리 제품의 제안 요구사항이다.

references.title: 월 지출 한도 설정

observed_steps.title: Spending Limit overview
observed_steps.goal: See the current team monthly spending limit and access controls to set or modify it.
observed_steps.action: User reviews the Billing & Usage → Spending Limit tab and clicks the 'Set limit' button (green with +).
observed_steps.system_response: The app opens a modal titled 'Set monthly spending limit' that contains an input for the monthly limit, explanatory text about notifications and enforcement, and action buttons (Cancel and Set limit).

observed_steps.title: Open set-limit modal (empty)
observed_steps.goal: Begin entering a new monthly limit value.
observed_steps.action: User focuses the 'Monthly limit' input inside the modal and types a numeric amount.
observed_steps.system_response: The input accepts the entered value and the modal shows a warning box explaining that once total usage reaches the limit, API requests will be blocked. The primary action (Set limit) becomes available for confirmation.

observed_steps.title: Enter limit value
observed_steps.goal: Confirm the desired monthly cap (example: $10).
observed_steps.action: User enters the amount (e.g., '10') and clicks the red 'Set limit' button to confirm.
observed_steps.system_response: The modal closes and the Spending Limit overview refreshes to reflect the newly saved amount. The page now shows the dollar amount in large type and displays a usage progress indicator for the current month.

observed_steps.title: Saved limit overview
observed_steps.goal: Verify the saved monthly limit and see current month usage relative to the limit; access edit/remove actions.
observed_steps.action: User inspects the displayed $10.00 USD limit and the progress bar; optionally clicks 'Edit limit' (pencil) to reopen the modal or clicks 'Remove' (trash) to delete the cap.
observed_steps.system_response: If Edit is clicked the modal reopens pre-filled with the current limit; if Remove is clicked the UI returns to the 'Unlimited' state. The dashboard shows month-to-date usage (e.g., January usage $0.00) and continues to surface the enforcement/notification copy.

observed_steps.title: Enter multiple emails

observed_steps.action: Paste or type multiple comma-separated email addresses into the Email input (example shows two addresses).

observed_steps.action: Click Send invites. Observe the members list update and confirmation notification.
observed_steps.system_response: Modal closes (or is dismissed) and the members table now includes an "Invited" section listing the newly-invited email addresses with a status indicating invited/pending. A transient toast appears confirming the number of invites sent and that invited members were notified by email.

references.title: 문서 업로드

observed_steps.title: New note — choose input type
observed_steps.goal: Start a new note/document and select how the content will be provided.
observed_steps.action: User enters a title (optional) and selects a content type from the type selector (Markdown selected by default).
observed_steps.system_response: The selected type is highlighted and determines the editor area below. Controls for the chosen type (e.g., file upload area for Markdown) are shown. A cancel/close control is available.

observed_steps.title: Add link and choose files
observed_steps.goal: Associate the new document with an existing node/collection and choose files to attach.
observed_steps.action: User optionally pastes or types a link into the 'Link to a node or add to a collection' field, then drags files into the central drop area or clicks 'Select file' to open the file picker.
observed_steps.system_response: The link becomes a token inside the link input. The file drop area accepts dragged files and the file picker opens when 'Select file' is clicked. Accepted file types and per-file size limits are displayed.

observed_steps.title: Files selected — choose save behavior
observed_steps.goal: Review how many files are selected and choose whether to save them to the system or insert them into the markdown content.
observed_steps.action: User sees the '6 files selected' message and chooses either 'Save all' or 'Insert into markdown'.
observed_steps.system_response: The UI shows the selected file count and exposes two primary actions: a primary 'Save all' button and a secondary 'Insert into markdown' button. Clicking an action initiates processing/uploading or insertion behavior.

observed_steps.title: Processing and uploading
observed_steps.goal: Allow the system to upload and process the selected files while preventing conflicting actions.
observed_steps.action: User waits for uploads to complete; no additional input is required (no visible cancel in screenshots).
observed_steps.system_response: The UI displays a processing/uploading state (progress indicator). Action buttons show progress or become visually disabled to indicate work in progress while the system uploads and processes the files.

observed_steps.title: Upload success confirmation
observed_steps.goal: Confirm to the user that files were saved and return them to the editing context.
observed_steps.action: User observes the success notification and continues editing or performs a next action (e.g., insert into markdown if desired).
observed_steps.system_response: A toast appears: '6 nodes saved successfully!'. The selected files remain indicated in the UI and actionable buttons are re-enabled. The system has persisted the files (nodes created) and notifies the user of completion.
